name: BA Better World
description: Fuselage: Forward and lower fuselage in pale aqua/turquoise blues with soft watercolor-style curved bands; aft upper fuselage white. Cheatlines: Curving light-blue/teal sweeps. Tail: BA Chatham-style flag fin rendered in pale blue, teal and white instead of red/white/blue. Engines: Teal/blue cowlings. Winglets: Sharklets (teal, approximate). Titles: 'BA Better World' in white forward; 'Our most important journey yet' in dark blue script-like type above the aft windows; small British Airways Speedmarque. Artwork: none. Colors hex: approximate.
